summary: One renderable cell on a form. The cell's name attribute (inherited from ) binds to a <field> in the parent entity's settings.xml, unless the cell is a custom one (uses the control_xxx naming convention with a <content> element instead of a field binding). See for the cell's UI-level overrides.

attributes.name: auto
attributes.summary: Auto-generated cell flag. Set to "true" on cells the runtime auto-created (e.g., system fields injected at form-load time). Most authored cells leave this empty; the framework manages the value.

attributes.name: colspan
attributes.summary: Number of grid columns the cell spans. Defaults to 1. Set to 2 (or higher) when the cell should occupy more horizontal space within the section's column grid (a 2-column section with a colspan-2 cell gives the cell the full row width).

attributes.name: cols
attributes.summary: Visual column count INSIDE the cell — for multi-column composite cells. Distinct from , which counts grid columns in the parent section.

attributes.name: description
attributes.summary: Tooltip / help text shown next to the cell label. Rendered as a small info icon or inline description depending on theme. Does not affect validation.

attributes.name: rowspan
attributes.summary: Number of grid rows the cell spans. Rarely used; most forms keep cells single-row and let layout flow handle taller cells (textareas, grids) by intrinsic height.

attributes.name: showhelp
attributes.summary: When true, renders the help/description text inline beneath the cell. When false, the description is shown only on hover/focus. Use sparingly — too many inline helps clutter the form.

attributes.name: showlabel
attributes.summary: When true, renders the cell's title/label above (or beside, depending on ) the input. When false, the input renders without a label — used for full-bleed grid cells and certain composite layouts.

attributes.name: titlealign
attributes.summary: Horizontal alignment of the title text relative to its container. Common values: left, center, right. Defaults to theme-dependent (usually left).

attributes.name: titlepos
attributes.summary: Title position relative to the input. Values: top (default) — title above input, full-width label.left — title beside input, narrow label column.

attributes.name: format
attributes.summary: Storage/data format hint for the cell value at the model layer. Common values: image (binary image), currency, percent, guid. Distinct from , which controls render formatting only.

attributes.name: displayFormat
attributes.summary: Render-time format string applied to the displayed value. Examples: yyyy-MM-dd for dates, 0.00 for decimal numbers, {0:N0} for grouped integers. Does not affect the underlying stored value.

children.name: content
children.summary: HTML/XML payload for custom cells. When set, the cell renders this content instead of binding to a settings.xml field. Triggers to return true. The naming convention for custom cells is control_<N> (e.g., control_288) — see the editable-grid-host recipe for the standard shape. Cross-reference validation skips cells with names starting with control_ because they intentionally don't bind to a field.

children.name: properties
children.summary: UI-level overrides for the cell. Carries required-level, readonly state, default values, watermark, lookup view override, etc. See .

attributes.name: valueExpression
attributes.summary: JS expression evaluated against { result, source, form } context. Used by: setValue, setReadonly, setRequired, toggleVisible.

attributes.name: when
attributes.summary: Optional boolean guard expression. When present the action is skipped if falsy.

attributes.name: message
attributes.summary: Message text for the notify verb.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.summary: Severity for the notify verb: info | success | warning | error.

attributes.name: propertyName
attributes.summary: Target property name for the setProperty verb.

summary: XML form of a single custom component validator. Authored inside a cell's <componentValidators> array; mapped at form-load time to the runtime ValidatorBase attached to the produced component configuration.

attributes.name: key
attributes.summary: Stable identifier for this validator. Surfaces in FormControl.errors[key]. Must be unique within the cell's validator array.

attributes.name: expression
attributes.summary: JS expression evaluated against { value, source, form }. Truthy = valid; falsy/string = invalid (string overrides ).

attributes.name: message
attributes.summary: Error text rendered when the validator fails. Supports ${...} token interpolation.

attributes.name: when
attributes.summary: Optional gate. When falsy, the validator is skipped (treated as valid).

attributes.name: validateOn
attributes.summary: When to run the validator: onChange (default) | onSave | manual.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.summary: Severity: error (default, blocks save) | warning | info. Also accepts a ${...} token expression for dynamic severity.

attributes.name: fetcher
attributes.summary: Named reference to a sibling <dataFetcher> component on the same form (Phase 2 escape hatch). The engine wraps that component's NGXS data slice into the result envelope. Mutually exclusive with and .

children.name: dataFetcher
children.summary: Inline single-fetcher backend probe (Phase 2). Authored as a <dataFetcher> child. The result is exposed to / as result. Mutually exclusive with and .

children.name: dataFetcher
children.summary: Inline multi-fetcher map (Phase 2). Authored as repeated <dataFetcher key="..."> entries inside a <dataFetchers> array; each entry's key becomes the identifier its envelope is referenced by in the expression (e.g. dup.ok). Mutually exclusive with and .

summary: XML authoring form of a validator's inline backend probe. Maps to the runtime DGF.Components.Shared.Validators.InlineDataFetcherDefinition. Authored either as the singular <dataFetcher> child of a <componentValidator> (surfaced to the expression as result) or as repeated <dataFetcher key="..."> entries inside a <dataFetchers> array (each surfaced to the expression by its ).

attributes.name: key
attributes.summary: Map key — used ONLY when this fetcher is an entry inside a <dataFetchers> array; becomes the dictionary key the validator expression references (e.g. dup.ok). Ignored for the singular <dataFetcher> form (that is always bound to result). Reserved keys (rejected by the runtime): value, source, form, result.

attributes.name: dataSourcePath
attributes.summary: Relative path to the backend dataSource the validator probes. Required.

attributes.name: valueExpression
attributes.summary: Optional post-processing expression evaluated against the raw response. When present, the validator's expression sees the result as data instead of the raw payload.

attributes.name: timeoutMs
attributes.summary: Per-probe timeout in milliseconds (range 0–60000). Defaults to the engine default (10000ms) when omitted. On timeout the envelope resolves with error.code === 'TIMEOUT' and the validator fails closed.

children.name: parameter
children.summary: Parameter bindings sent with the probe. Same shape as a query component's parameters.

children.name: componentEvent
children.summary: Optional declarative handlers, evaluated alongside the legacy CDATA script. Maps to FormScript.{OnLoad|OnSave|OnInitialize}Events via XmlFormMappingService. Coexists with the CDATA path; neither replaces the other.

children.name: componentEvent
children.summary: Optional declarative handlers, evaluated alongside the legacy CDATA script. Maps to FormScript.{OnLoad|OnSave|OnInitialize}Events via XmlFormMappingService. Coexists with the CDATA path; neither replaces the other.

attributes.name: labelwidth
attributes.summary: Form-wide default label column width. Accepts CSS-compatible width (e.g., "200px", "30%"). Individual sections may override via . Affects only cells with titlepos="left"; top-positioned titles ignore this.

attributes.name: padding
attributes.summary: Padding mode for the form container. Common values: compact, normal, roomy. Theme-dependent; controls vertical spacing between sections and cells.

attributes.name: checkChanges
attributes.summary: Controls whether the form prompts the user before navigating away with unsaved changes. Accepts "true" (warn on navigate-away) or "false" (no warning). Defaults to true. Set to false for view-only or auto-save forms.

attributes.name: toolbar
attributes.summary: Toolbar visibility / behaviour. Common values: "true" — render full toolbar (Save, Cancel, etc.)."false" — no toolbar; caller embeds buttons elsewhere."compact" — icon-only toolbar.

attributes.name: provider
attributes.summary: Optional data-provider override. When set, the form uses the named provider for loading/saving instead of the default Table-bound provider. Used for forms that front a non-table data source (e.g., an API-backed entity).

children.name: tab
children.summary: Visible tabs in the form. Most forms have a single tab; multi-tab forms split long field groups into focused tabs (General / Documents / History etc.). Tabs render as horizontal strip at the top of the form.

children.name: cell
children.summary: Cells that never render to the user but must exist on the form for the runtime to populate them at save time. This is where the universal audit block lives (CreatedBy/IP/On + ModifiedBy/IP/On with ~USERID/~IP/~NOW defaults). Distinct from a section with visible="false" — hidden cells skip layout entirely; an invisible section still occupies its slot in the tab structure.

children.name: componentValidator
children.summary: Form-level custom validators — cross-component invariants authored on the <form> root rather than a single cell (e.g. "foreign nationals must upload AND verify a passport"). Mapped onto the FormComponent's own configuration; the frontend detects componentName === formName and renders failures as a top-of-form banner that gates SAVE/NEXT.

children.name: componentEvent
children.summary: Optional declarative handlers, evaluated alongside the legacy CDATA script. Maps to FormScript.{OnLoad|OnSave|OnInitialize}Events via XmlFormMappingService. Coexists with the CDATA path; neither replaces the other.

children.name: componentEvent
children.summary: Optional declarative handlers, evaluated alongside the legacy CDATA script. Maps to FormScript.{OnLoad|OnSave|OnInitialize}Events via XmlFormMappingService. Coexists with the CDATA path; neither replaces the other.

summary: The <properties> child element on a form cell. Carries UI-level overrides that the form runtime applies on top of the settings.xml field definition — required level, readonly state, default values, lookup view overrides, watermark, etc. Cell-side properties NEVER override the field-side required/readonly when the field is system-required or system-readonly.

attributes.name: behavior
attributes.summary: Polymorphic hint for the runtime renderer: Lookup: autocomplete — render as autocomplete instead of dialog.TextBox: lookup:<table>/<view> — render textbox-with-lookup hybrid.File: style=… — style string for the uploader chip.Number: min|max — range constraint applied at UI level. Free-form because the value is interpreted differently per cell type.

attributes.name: format
attributes.summary: UI display-format override. Cell-level format wins over field-level. Common values: currency, percent, image, a date format string like yyyy-MM-dd, or a numeric mask. Leave empty to inherit from .

attributes.name: gridname
attributes.summary: Name of a sub-grid configuration when the cell hosts an inline grid. Rarely set directly on a cell — most grid hosts use the control_xxx custom-cell pattern with a <content> CDATA block instead.

attributes.name: handlermode
attributes.summary: Switches the cell into a specialised handler mode. Used by composite cells (e.g., a File cell that doubles as an attachment-list trigger). Free-form; consult the matching FormCellComponent docs for valid values.

attributes.name: itemTemplate
attributes.summary: HTML/template fragment used to render each item in a Lookup/Picklist dropdown. Supports the standard ${field} token syntax referencing columns of the lookup view. Use to show richer items than a single label (e.g., name + secondary detail).

attributes.name: inputGroupSkipDisableAndReadOnlyForAddons
attributes.summary: InputGroup-specific: when true, addon buttons stay clickable even when the cell is disabled or readonly. Set this when the addons trigger out-of-band actions (e.g., a "calculate" button that runs even on read-only forms).

attributes.name: lines
attributes.summary: Visible line count for a TextArea cell. Defaults vary by component; typical values are 3–6. Sets the textarea's rows attribute on render.

attributes.name: oncreatevalue
attributes.summary: Default value applied to the cell at create time (form opened for a new record). Supports the DGF context-token convention: ~USERID, ~IP, ~NOW, ~APPLICATIONID, plus the standard ${...} expression syntax. Audit cells (CreatedBy/IP/On) set this universally.

attributes.name: onupdatevalue
attributes.summary: Default value applied at update time. Combine with for audit cells that refresh on every save (ModifiedBy/IP/On). When omitted, the cell retains its current value across updates.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.summary: Readonly override for the cell. Accepts "true", "label" (renders as a label instead of a disabled input), or any falsy string. Cell-side readonly stacks with field-side: if EITHER is true, the cell is readonly. A system-required cell cannot be made readonly via this attribute.

attributes.name: requiredlevel
attributes.summary: Required-level override. Three values are meaningful: "required" — form submission blocked until value provided."recommended" — soft requirement; form submits but the cell flags as recommended-empty.(omitted) — inherits from the matching settings.xml field's required attribute. System-required fields cannot be downgraded via this attribute.

attributes.name: view
attributes.summary: View name override for Lookup/Picklist cells. When set, the lookup dialog and the picklist source use the named view instead of the field's default. Used to filter the lookup down to a subset (e.g., "active-only") without changing the field definition. The view must exist on the matching extract table.

attributes.name: watermark
attributes.summary: Placeholder text shown in empty input cells (the HTML placeholder attribute). Used to hint at expected format, e.g., "Full legal name" or "YYYY-MM-DD". Does not affect validation; pair with for format enforcement.

attributes.name: emptyOptionName
attributes.summary: Display label for the "no selection" item in a Picklist. Defaults to localised equivalent of "(empty)". Override when the dropdown should look different (e.g., "All districts" for a filter-shaped picklist).

attributes.name: emptyOptionValue
attributes.summary: Value bound to the "no selection" item. Usually empty string or null; set when a sentinel value is needed for downstream binding (e.g., "0" for an integer foreign key that should default to a known "all" row).

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.summary: Regular-expression validation applied at the UI layer. Failing the regex blocks form submission and shows . Cell-side validation runs in addition to settings.xml field-side validation; both must pass.

attributes.name: patternValidationMessage
attributes.summary: Message shown to the user when the regex fails. Keep short and actionable; the user sees this inline next to the field.

summary: A single row in a 's grid. Holds 1-N cells which flow left-to-right across the section's column count. Use empty <cell /> elements as layout fillers when a row has fewer cells than columns.

children.name: cell
children.summary: Cells in this row. Cells with colspan > 1 take more horizontal space; the runtime wraps to the next row if cells exceed the section's column count.

summary: A visual grouping of rows/cells inside a . Renders a titled section with optional decoration line. Use the legacy array OR the newer array — not both. The visible="false" override is the standard way to hide context/debug sections without removing them from XML.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.summary: Visibility override. Set to literal "false" to hide the section while keeping its cells available for context binding (e.g., the hidden debug section pattern that carries ApplicationId/CaseId for workflow scoping). Any other value (or omission) renders the section normally. Read via .

attributes.name: columns
attributes.summary: Number of grid columns inside the section. Typical values: 1 (single column) or 2 (paired cells per row). Cells with colspan="2" in a 2-column section take the full row width.

attributes.name: decoration
attributes.summary: Visual border treatment around the section. Common values: line (default) — thin border with title at top-left.box — full bordered box around the section.(empty) — no decoration, section blends into the form.

attributes.name: labelwidth
attributes.summary: Override the form-level label column width for cells in this section. Used when one section needs wider labels (e.g., verbose field titles) without changing the rest of the form. Accepts CSS-compatible width (e.g., "200px", "30%").

attributes.name: marginTop
attributes.summary: Extra top-margin applied to the section's container. Used to visually separate stacked sections beyond the default theme spacing. Accepts a CSS value.

attributes.name: name
attributes.summary: Section identifier. Should be unique within the form (the runtime does NOT enforce this strictly, but PropertyConvertors and inter-section bindings rely on it). Convention: sec_<purpose> or numbered sec1234. The hidden debug section is typically named sec_context or similar.

attributes.name: showlabel
attributes.summary: When true, renders the section's title heading. When false, the section's cells render in a labelled-but-untitled container — useful when the section is purely structural (hidden context, grouped audit cells).

children.name: cell
children.summary: Legacy direct-cells layout (pre-2009 grids). New forms should use instead — Rows give explicit control over multi-column grids, while this Cells array flows left-to-right in -wide chunks.

children.name: row
children.summary: Modern row-based layout. Each row contains 1-N cells laid out across the section's grid. Prefer this over the legacy array for new forms.

summary: A single tab in a multi-tab form. Tabs are rendered as horizontal tab strip at the top of the form; each tab owns one or more s. Single-tab forms are common (the tab strip simply renders as a heading); multi-tab forms split related field groups across tabs to manage long forms.

attributes.name: name
attributes.summary: Tab identifier. Convention: tab_<purpose> (e.g., tab_general, tab_attachments). The runtime uses this for tab-selection state across reloads and for cross-tab references in PropertyConvertors.

children.name: section
children.summary: Sections contained in this tab. Sections render in order, stacked vertically within the tab body.

attributes.name: onbeforesave
attributes.summary: Tri-state via the companion (canonical XmlSerializer pattern): when the onbeforesave attribute is missing, OnBeforeSaveSpecified == false and the bool defaults to false; when present, the bool reflects the parsed value and Specified flips to true. XmlFormMappingService uses this distinction to gate FormScript.OnSave + FormScript.OnSaveEvents only on an explicitonbeforesave="false" — empty <triggers/> elements remain inert (legacy default preserved).
